messages:
Nadia: 12-min heads-up for all-hands (09:00 PT). Small agenda tweak: timeline Q&A moved to 09:30 so we can fit the security update at 09:10. Presenters pls join 'Presenters' Zoom 5m early.
Carlos: Quick one  are captions enabled by default on the stream path? Last time captions dropped after an OBS scene switch.
Priya: Captions are enabled but the passthrough depends on the RTMP bridge. I swapped bridges yesterday; will verify passthrough now.
stream-bot: Stream infra (us-central-1) status: OK. Active RTMP bridges: 4. Caption passthrough: true. Encoder pool health: nominal.
Evan: Request: enable dual-recording (OBS local + cloud) and set S3 retention to 30d for public decks, 7d for confidential. We should also tag confidential files with restricted ACL.
Nadia: Good plan. Security: please ping @sec-team if you need a manual retention override.
Priya: Running encoder check:
```
curl -fsS https://streaming.redwood.com/health | jq '.encoders[] | select(.region=="us-central-1") | {id,status,version,caption_passthrough}'
```
Priya: Check shows encoder v2.1.5, caption_passthrough=true. OBS key matches expected.
Carlos: Zoom check for presenters: paste output of `zoom --version` here. If anyone's <5.14 we need an upgrade.
Evan: I'm on 5.15.2 Linux. Camera + mic OK.
Nadia: Note for hosts: during Q&A ask folks to paste short one-line questions in chat and use raise hand. We'll prioritize security and roadmap questions. Mike will triage.
stream-bot: Recording started at 09:01:08 PT. Cloud file: s3://redwood-allhands/2026-05-02/1763009999-recording.mp4. Local backup detected on host "evan-laptop".
Priya: Local OBS upload queued; ETA ~1m. If captions fail we'll switch to audio-only stream and post recording link asap.
Carlos: Also flagging live captions accuracy concerns for dense code blocks  teams may prefer manual transcript for those segments.
Nadia: Thanks all. After the meeting we'll open follow-up threads for any unanswered roadmap questions and attach the recording with ACL notes. See you shortly. :thumbsup:
